[09_appeals_and_complaints#3]
Appeals and complaints. Complaints. If you are unhappy with our service, rather than a claim decision, you can make a complaint through the member portal or in writing.

[08_after_you_submit#3]
What happens after you submit a claim. No outcome is guaranteed before a claim is assessed. Staff and online help cannot confirm in advance that a claim will be paid. The decision is made by a claims assessor once the claim and documents have been reviewed.

[09_appeals_and_complaints#2]
Appeals and complaints. How to appeal. Reply to the decision letter or use the member portal, and say why you think the decision is wrong. Include anything that was missing from the original claim, for example a referral, a pre-authorisation number, or a provider's description showing an injury was accidental.
